content: Sulfanilamide is classified as an anti-infective agent. Chemically, it is p-aminobenzenesulfonamide. It appears as a white, odorless crystalline powder that has a slightly bitter taste, followed by a sweet aftertaste. The compound exhibits slight solubility in water, alcohol, acetone, glycerin, propylene glycol, hydrochloric acid, and solutions of potassium and sodium hydroxide. However, it is practically insoluble in chloroform, ether, benzene, and petroleum ether.
